The '''orycat''' was a small woodland predator native to [[Orryxia]] that could be found in packs of 12-24. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] official [[Wilek Nereus]] obtained a dental specimen of an orycat but was unable to complete a survey of its environment due to inclement conditions.
